_comment: Paper registry for the leaderboard: one entry per audited paper, newest audit first. Card paths are relative to this directory and every graded card under references/ must appear in exactly one entry (stresskit scoreboard / site fail otherwise). Free-text fields are rendered verbatim in the scoreboard and on the site.

papers.title: REINS-Gate: sparse SAE-feature router for refusal-enhanced inhibitory steering
papers.models: Qwen3.5-2B-Base with the released REINS-SAE bundle (the 4B preset not run)
papers.reproduced: yes: the released 2B gates replayed on the paper's evaluation split open on 0.993 of harmful and 0.053 of matched-safe prompts (paper 0.987 / 0.047); the refit reproduces the routing (0.990 / 0.007) with 34-45% of the released coordinates per category, the paper's unreleased general-prompt negatives being the difference
papers.result: the routing is stable (harmful open >= 0.987 in every real run, matched-safe <= 0.11) but the coordinate set is not: split seed and pair resample keep J 0.92 / 0.87 while top-k, layer window and rendering halve it (J 0.50 / 0.53; pooled 0.83, axis-balanced 0.71); the 10% false-positive budget is a property of the calibration wrapper: the released gate opens on 0.64 of the same matched-safe prompts rendered without the answer template and 0.15 under a paraphrased one; a label-permuted gate opens on 0.02-0.26 / 0.00-0.19

papers.title: Sparse Weight Decomposition for efficient circuit extraction, GPT-2 single-matrix fidelity and circuit frontier
papers.models: GPT-2 small, layer-8 mlp.c_proj (the Qwen2.5 and Qwen3.5-27B surfaces not run)
papers.reproduced: KL and output cosine yes (0.001871 -> 0.001884, 0.9814 -> 0.9815); CE delta 0.000889 -> 0.001423 on a different 16-block calibration draw, inside the released grid's own 0.0009-0.0027 spread; the greater-than headline reproduces: 48 units at sufficiency 0.9 against the Transcoder's 384 (released SWD 48; edges 75,611 vs released 75,327), while necessity costs come out 2-3x the released ones (64 vs 24 units at 0.9)
papers.result: the released one-unit sufficiency cells for IOI and docstring are a denominator artifact (mean-ablating the whole projection raises the IOI margin, so sufficiency swings from -5.6 to +1.7 across k); SWD's unit and edge advantage on gendered-pronoun reproduces in 20 of 22 runs (32-64 units vs the Transcoder's 128) and survives random-token calibration; the 'matched to TC-12k within 0.001' bucket flips in 10 of 22 runs

papers.title: Steering vectors for chain-of-thought faithfulness, cross-cue vector convergence
papers.reproduced: yes, exactly: all 12 native-layer cosines and 6 cross-method cosines from the shipped vectors, the 4 shipped synthetic vectors at cosine 1.000 with the rebuilt ones, and the L17 / L11 cross-cue means 0.880 / 0.959 (paper 0.88 / 0.96)
papers.result: the cross-cue convergence survives any task subsample but is a property of the appended completion sentences, not of the cue: paraphrased completions give 0.49-0.54 at L17, prompts with no cue still converge at 0.82, an identical cue-agnostic completion converges at every layer; steering at alpha 5 leaves rule-detected acknowledgment at 0.70 -> 0.69

papers.title: HARC: coupling harmfulness and refusal directions, released adapters
papers.models: Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, each with the released HARC LoRA
papers.reproduced: Figure 1's base profile on Llama, yes (peak L12, cos 0.42 over L8-16 vs 0.12 over L20-28) and upstream's layer selection lands in the paper's trained bands; Table 1's over-refusal direction, no: under a hard-refusal string match the Llama adapter refuses 29 of 250 XSTest safe prompts against 17 for the base (paper 0.035 vs 0.109), Qwen 11 vs 10
papers.result: the coupling gain is real (band +0.55 on Llama, 9.6x random) but not localised: 41 of 64 cells gain >= 0.10, the gain starts eight layers upstream of the trained band, and permuted-label directions gain +0.28 at the same layers (specificity 1.15x, undecided); on Qwen the gain peaks at L18, upstream of the paper's L21-24 band, and disappears in band under the Circuit Breakers / UltraChat pools

papers.title: Cultural awareness is represented but not decoded (FolkMotif)
papers.reproduced: yes, exactly: probe 0.881 at layer 8, n-gram 0.604, buckets 45/193/5/27; the paper's 0.248 is its rescored run and its 32/206/6/26 row is the native-prompt run, both exact
papers.result: the qualitative claim never flips; Preserved cells move 5-83 with the aggregation rule and template, and the peak layer moves over layers 6-14 with the CV split

papers.title: Diff Mining: logit differences reveal finetuning objectives (judge-free token-set battery)
papers.reproduced: no released token lists; the paper's metric is a gpt-5-mini judge and its bias number needs a 70B model, neither run
papers.result: top-100 token set stable across 60 seeds, 60 resamples and two corpora (J 0.97 / 0.96 / 0.88; pooled 0.92, axis-balanced 0.81, hyperparams axis 0.43), 65% finetune-domain vocabulary under a pre-registered rule; scrambled adapter gives garbage (0-36%); 0.48 under logit-lens extraction, 0.26 for the 1:1-mix LoRA

papers.title: Dissociating the internal representations of sycophancy
papers.reproduced: Llama within 0.02-0.10 of Tables 1-2 and Gemma within 0.01-0.06 of Table 1, both at the paper's final layer, which the released extractor's lexicographic layer order makes decoder layer 9 on either model
papers.result: Llama distinct (transfer drop >= 0.15) holds in 87 of 88 runs but flips to shared at the best in-domain layer (L12); Gemma aligned holds in 48 of 48 runs at every layer choice (drop 0.02-0.05); the cross-model difference is 2.8-5.5x at every matched layer, a difference of degree, while the distinct-versus-aligned dichotomy depends on Llama's layer choice; which Llama layers carry the drop is unstable (J 0.53)

papers.title: The Communication Map of a Transformer
papers.reproduced: yes, all 21 Table 2 shares exactly
papers.result: the abstract's 70-89% holds only pooled per model (69.7-89.0%); 4 of 21 per-channel entries fall outside (60.7-90.5%); the lower bound is a rounding edge under resampling; |z|>=3 gives 59-83% with six exceptions

papers.title: Expander sparse autoencoders
papers.reproduced: yes: 0.831 / 0.978 CE-recovered vs 0.833 / 0.983 shipped, ratio 0.850 vs 0.842
papers.result: ratio 0.80-0.90 over 30 seeds and 30 resamples, flips only at the 0.80 bucket edge; k=32 gives 0.66, a mean-ablation denominator 0.77

papers.title: Conditional co-ablation (CoAx) backup-head recovery
papers.reproduced: yes against the released reference metrics (0.945 vs 0.941); the abstract's from-0.33 single-ablation baseline is 0.60 in the released code
papers.result: label-free primaries collapse CoAx to 0.28 / 0.38 AUC while AtP* stays 0.83; one of three templates loses to AtP*; the no-IOI null recovers the same heads at 0.93-0.97, so the backup structure is task-general

papers.title: Activation Model Scanner, Tier-1 safety scan
papers.models: 14 models of Table I (Llama 3.1/3.2, gemma-2, Qwen2.5, Mistral; instruct, base, abliterated, uncensored)
papers.reproduced: yes, all 14 sigma values to two decimals through the released extractor
papers.result: the released extractor reads pad-token activations for the 10 right-padded tokenizers; with batch size 1 or left padding every model scores sigma 4.5-6.7, nothing is flagged, LOO accuracy 0.14, r flips to +0.28 n.s.

papers.title: Certified Interventional Fidelity on GPT-2 IOI circuits
papers.reproduced: yes, 30 of 30 shipped rows exactly
papers.result: certified level depends on the template (0.95 upstream, 0.9 on seven of eleven others, none on one); the 10-30x is 6.6-7.2x at F0=0.8 and 18-19x at 0.9

papers.title: Refusal in language models is mediated by a single direction
papers.models: Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Qwen3.5-4B, Qwen3.5-9B, gemma-4-E4B-it, gemma-4-12B-it
papers.reproduced: the causal claim reproduces on every model
papers.result: the causal effect holds hard (specificity 4-1293x); which direction gets selected is unstable (J 0.18-0.39); two measurement artifacts found in raw completions

papers.title: SAE causal inertness audit
papers.models: toy bottleneck model with two TopK SAEs (released harness)
papers.reproduced: run 2 within the paper's own band
papers.result: the inert-pair census is unstable (J 0.33); the abstract's headline has a different denominator than its sentence

papers.title: Homonym reconvergence profiles
papers.reproduced: stimuli and the Table 1 tokenisation counts reproduce exactly
papers.result: the profile label comes back in 28/31 to 32/32 runs, but the paper's own sequence-order control produces the same label (specificity 0.88-1.08x); magnitude separates homonyms from controls, the shape does not

papers.title: Truth vs impossibility probes
papers.reproduced: yes, same model snapshot
papers.result: the double dissociation survives resampling, re-splitting and hyperparameters; specificity 1.84x

papers.title: Mechanistic tomography: OMP recovery of a finite-effect map
papers.reproduced: yes, bit-exact
papers.result: the four bin-7 coordinates are real and specific; the support beyond them is not stable (J 0.40)

papers.title: Jacobian-lens readouts (anthropics/jacobian-lens release) and lens baselines
papers.reproduced: released lenses used as shipped
papers.result: the mid-to-late-band claim is stable (pi* 0.90); which items hit is not (J 0.45-0.49), and the deranged-target null hits more consistently than the real targets (specificity 0.78x)

papers.title: Activation oracles
papers.models: Qwen3-8B taboo subjects, three released oracle mixtures
papers.reproduced: pre-trained oracles run as shipped
papers.result: accuracy 0.09-0.45 with null hallucination about 0.9; the instrument is prompt-dominated

papers.title: Indirect object identification circuit under attribution patching
papers.reproduced: classic task, no single released number under test
papers.result: J 0.83-0.95, specificity 1.5-2.3x; no monotone trend with scale: medium is the only certifiable A, small and large stay undecided after 45 runs

papers.title: Greater-than circuit under attribution patching
papers.reproduced: classic task, no single released number under test
papers.result: J 0.89 but specificity 1.15x: the head set is nearly as stable on the corrupted null
